Source handlers are implemented, but database/provider/runtime behaviour has not been verified and feature flags default disabled. Not the published runtime contract.

200.description: Success. If data is User, a session is issued and Set-Cookie is emitted. If data.mfaRequired is true, no session is issued and no Set-Cookie header is emitted.

Set-Cookie.description: Conditional: emitted only when data is the User branch; never emitted for data.mfaRequired=true. When emitted it sets sap_session and rotates sap_csrf.

get.summary: Dependency readiness dengan status aman per komponen

200.description: DB-backed read traffic can be served; auxiliary dependencies may be degraded

503.description: Database unavailable; safe read traffic cannot be served

parameters.description: Search public summary, category, report ID, or report date.

sapaEnabled.description: Preferensi teman virtual SAPA. Default true untuk akun baru; UI membaca ini saat bootstrap. Lihat addendum SAPA_ASSISTANT.md.

avatarMediaId.description: Media id foto profil (purpose=avatar) milik akun, atau null. Klien menukarnya jadi URL bertanda tangan via GET /media/{id}/url.

PageContext.description: Halaman aplikasi tempat pesan SAPA dikirim; hanya untuk memilih saran yang relevan. Bukan identitas/otorisasi.

AssistantTarget.description: Rute internal yang disetujui untuk tombol saran SAPA. Frontend memetakan nilai ini ke route; bukan URL bebas.

AssistantCitation.description: Sumber terkurasi yang menjadi dasar jawaban SAPA. `id` merujuk entri korpus yang benar-benar ada dalam KONTEKS; SAPA tidak mengarang kartu sitasi.

url.description: URL sumber eksternal bila ada; null untuk FAQ internal.

UserPreferencesInput.description: Hanya field preferensi yang boleh diubah. userId/role diambil dari session, tidak dari body.

conversationId.description: Null saat memulai percakapan; setelah itu pakai ID opaque dari server.

citations.description: Kartu sumber terkurasi yang mendasari jawaban. Boleh kosong bila jawaban tidak bersandar pada entri korpus tertentu.

mediaId.description: Uploaded scan photo owned by the authenticated account. Resolve with GET /media/{mediaId}/url; older responses may omit this field.

x-domain-rules: resolved requires exactly one evidence path; verified→resolved only approved resolution evidence; every claim current, same source, non-revoked and not older than latest accepted observation

ScanSettings.description: Konfigurasi hybrid scan detection (runtime, dapat diubah admin).

ScanSettingsUpdateInput.description: Partial update; hanya field yang dikirim yang berubah.

ChangePasswordInput.description: Ganti kata sandi saat masuk. currentPassword diverifikasi; identitas diambil dari session, bukan body.

SetAvatarInput.description: Pasang atau lepas foto profil. mediaId harus media purpose=avatar milik pemanggil; null melepas foto. Identitas dari session, bukan body.

MfaRequired.description: Password verified, but no session exists yet. Use preauthToken at POST /auth/mfa/login; the server does not set a session cookie for this branch.

LoginResult.description: Either an authenticated User (session cookie set), or an MFA challenge (no session cookie). The mfaRequired discriminator is present only on the challenge branch.

MfaEnrollment.description: One-time provisioning URI; do not persist or log.

MfaRecoveryCodes.description: Plaintext recovery codes are revealed once and cannot be fetched again.

MfaCurrentCodeInput.description: Identity is taken from the authenticated session, never from this body.

x-domain-rules: renditionId required non-null when approved=true; current relationship, ready rendition and active channel consent required
hold/resume/cancel require reason 5–1000; other actions permit null

SetCookie.description: Sets or clears a host-only cookie. All auth cookies are HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, Path=/. sap_csrf carries the signed double-submit CSRF token (GET /auth/csrf; rotated on login/logout). sap_session is the opaque session token set on verify-email/login and cleared on logout, reset-password, and account deletion. sap_deletion is the account-deletion receipt set by DELETE /users/me. A single response may emit more than one Set-Cookie line.
